title: Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence
abstract: arXiv:2606.06479v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training recurrent neural networks (RNNs) requires assigning credit across long sequences of computations. Standard backpropagation through time (BPTT) addresses this problem poorly: it is sequential in time, limiting parallelism, and suffers from vanishing or exploding gradients, making long-range associations difficult to learn. We propose Supervised Memory Training (SMT), a method for training nonlinear RNNs that sidesteps recurrent credit propagation entirely by reducing RNN training to supervised learning on one-step memory transition labels $(m_t, x_{t+1}) \rightarrow m_{t+1}$. SMT acquires these memory labels by training a Transformer-based encoder on a predictive state objective--retaining only information from the past necessary to predict the future. By decoupling what to remember from how to update memory, SMT enables time-parallel RNN training with a stable $O(1)$ length gradient path between any two tokens--without

translated_title: 无需循环的循环网络预训练
translated_abstract: 训练循环神经网络需要在长计算序列上进行信用分配。标准的沿时间反向传播（BPTT）方法对此问题的处理效果不佳：它在时间上是顺序进行的，限制了并行性，并且存在梯度消失或梯度爆炸的问题，使得长程关联难以学习。我们提出了监督记忆训练，这是一种训练非线性RNN的方法，它通过将RNN训练简化为对单步记忆转移标签 $(m_t, x_{t+1}) \rightarrow m_{t+1}$ 的监督学习，完全绕开了循环信用传播。SMT通过在一个预测状态目标上训练基于Transformer的编码器来获取这些记忆标签——即仅保留过去中预测未来所必需的信息。通过将“记住什么”与“如何更新记忆”解耦，SMT实现了时间上并行的RNN训练，任意两个token之间的梯度路径长度稳定为O(1)——无需……
tldr: 本文提出监督记忆训练（SMT）方法，将RNN训练转化为对由Transformer编码器生成的单步记忆转移标签的监督学习，从而完全绕过循环信用传播，实现时间并行训练，且任意两个token之间的梯度路径长度稳定为O(1)。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Supervised Memory Training (SMT), which reduces RNN training to supervised learning on one-step memory transition labels generated by a Transformer-based encoder, entirely bypassing recurrent credit propagation and enabling time-parallel training with stable O(1)-length gradient paths between any two tokens.
